jp: ああ、アリスは私が置いてきたわ。ハッキリ言ってこのネフィアにはついていけない…。
jp_grezzo: "ああ、アリスは私が置いてきたわ。ハッキリ言ってこのネフィアにはついていけない…。"
en: Oh, I've left Alice and I told her clearly to not follow me to Nefia.
en_grezzo: "Oh, I've left Alice and I told her clearly to not follow me to Nefia."
it: Ah, Alice l'ho lasciata indietro io. Diciamocelo: a questa Nefia non riesco a stare dietro...

jp: 森の王様の力も借りてここまで来たけれど、ちょっと…いや、かなり厳しくなってきたわね。あなたはまだ余裕がありそうね…すごいわ。
jp_grezzo: "森の王様の力も借りてここまで来たけれど、ちょっと…いや、かなり厳しくなってきたわね。あなたはまだ余裕がありそうね…すごいわ。"
en: I'll borrow the power of the king of the forest... hang on, ...oh no! Maybe that was a bit too much. Yet you still have power in you... how wonderful.
en_grezzo: "I'll borrow the power of the king of the forest... hang on, ...oh no! Maybe that was a bit too much. Yet you still have power in you... how wonderful."
it: Sono arrivata fin qui grazie anche al re della foresta, ma si è fatta un po'... anzi, parecchio dura. Tu invece sei in scioltezza... che roba.

jp: 蟲の研究ができなくなるのは困るから、私たちは神の間を真面目に目指しているのよ。これでも一応はね。
jp_grezzo: "蟲の研究ができなくなるのは困るから、私たちは神の間を真面目に目指しているのよ。これでも一応はね。"
en: Losing our insect research was bit off a problem, but we have the goal of making the relations between the gods grave. This will have to do for now.
en_grezzo: "Losing our insect research was bit off a problem, but we have the goal of making the relations between the gods grave. This will have to do for now."
it: Restare senza i nostri studi sugli insetti sarebbe un guaio, quindi al Sigillo Eterno ci puntiamo sul serio. Nel nostro piccolo, eh.

jp: 娘には内緒よ？
jp_grezzo: "娘には内緒よ？"
en: Keep this a secret from my daughter, okay?
en_grezzo: "Keep this a secret from my daughter, okay?"
it: Acqua in bocca con mia figlia, mi raccomando.

jp: 薬をあげてきてくれたのね！さて、アリスの様子は…。
jp_grezzo: "薬をあげてきてくれたのね！さて、アリスの様子は…。"
en: The medicine is done! Now then, Alice's form...
en_grezzo: "The medicine is done! Now then, Alice's form..."
it: Gliel'hai data, la medicina! Bene, vediamo come sta Alice...

jp: し、死んどる…。
jp_grezzo: "し、死んどる…。"
en: Sh-she's dead...
en_grezzo: "Sh-she's dead..."
it: M-morta stecchita...

jp: ！？アリス…その姿は…？
jp_grezzo: "！？アリス…その姿は…？"
en: ?! Alice... That form...?
en_grezzo: "?! Alice... That form...?"
it: ?! Alice... quella forma...?

jp: 完全に元通りになれたのね！一時はどうなることかと思ったのよ。…人語もちゃんと喋れるみたいね。本当によかった。
jp_grezzo: "完全に元通りになれたのね！一時はどうなることかと思ったのよ。…人語もちゃんと喋れるみたいね。本当によかった。"
en: You've completely recovered! I do wonder if it's only temporary though... But it looks like you can speak properly too. I'm so glad.
en_grezzo: "You've completely recovered! I do wonder if it's only temporary though... But it looks like you can speak properly too. I'm so glad."
it: Sei tornata come prima, tutta intera! Per un momento ho temuto il peggio. ...E a quanto pare parli di nuovo come le persone. Che sollievo.

jp: さん、ありがとう！これで娘に嫌われずに済むわ。預かってる最中にあんな姿に変異させたことが知れたら…おおぅ。
jp_grezzo: "" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "さん、ありがとう！これで娘に嫌われずに済むわ。預かってる最中にあんな姿に変異させたことが知れたら…おおぅ。"
en: , thank you! With this, there's no need for my daughter to hate me. If she knew that I had caused this mutation... Oh my.
en_grezzo: "" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", thank you! With this, there's no need for my daughter to hate me. If she knew that I had caused this mutation... Oh my."
contesto: chatMore lang("" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "さん、ありがとう！これで娘に嫌われずに済むわ。預かってる最中にあんな姿に変異させたことが知れたら…おおぅ。", "" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", thank you! With this, there's no need for my daughter to hate me. If she knew that I had caused this mutation... Oh my.")
it: cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", grazie! Così mia figlia non mi odierà. Se venisse a sapere che gliel'ho ridotta in quello stato mentre me la teneva in custodia... ohi ohi."

jp: え？アリスは娘じゃないわよ。そんなこと一度も言ってないけど…？アリスは森で迷いアリになっていたところを私の娘に拾われたの。今では娘の大事なペット…いや子分かしら？そりゃあ元に戻ったと言っても、結局はアリのままの姿よ。
jp_grezzo: "え？アリスは娘じゃないわよ。そんなこと一度も言ってないけど…？アリスは森で迷いアリになっていたところを私の娘に拾われたの。今では娘の大事なペット…いや子分かしら？そりゃあ元に戻ったと言っても、結局はアリのままの姿よ。"
en: Huh? Alice isn't my daughter. Did I say that at some point...? Alice is an ant that was picked up by my daughter one day when she got lost in the forest. Now she's my daughter's precious pet... or maybe follower? So, I said she's back to normal because, after all, her true appearance is that of an ant.
en_grezzo: "Huh? Alice isn't my daughter. Did I say that at some point...? Alice is an ant that was picked up by my daughter one day when she got lost in the forest. Now she's my daughter's precious pet... or maybe follower? So, I said she's back to normal because, after all, her true appearance is that of an ant."
it: Eh? Alice non è mia figlia. Non l'ho mai detto, che io ricordi...? Alice si era persa nel bosco ed era una formica randagia, e mia figlia l'ha raccolta. Adesso è la sua bestiola del cuore... o forse il suo braccio destro? E comunque, \"tornata come prima\" vuol dire che resta pur sempre una formica.

jp: とにかく、これは報酬＆口止め料よ。本当に助かったわ！
jp_grezzo: "とにかく、これは報酬＆口止め料よ。本当に助かったわ！"
en: Anyways, here's your reward - with a little extra thrown in for your silence. You really helped me out!
en_grezzo: "Anyways, here's your reward - with a little extra thrown in for your silence. You really helped me out!"
it: Insomma, questo è il compenso più il prezzo del silenzio. Mi hai salvata davvero!

jp: 悪いけど、アリスに薬をあげるところまでお願い。
jp_grezzo: "悪いけど、アリスに薬をあげるところまでお願い。"
en: Sorry, but please properly give the medicine to Alice.
en_grezzo: "Sorry, but please properly give the medicine to Alice."
it: Scusa, ma la medicina dalla tu ad Alice, fino in fondo.

jp: それじゃあ。持ってきてほしいアイテムなんだけど、いくつかあるから簡単そうなものからお願いしようかしら。
jp_grezzo: "それじゃあ。持ってきてほしいアイテムなんだけど、いくつかあるから簡単そうなものからお願いしようかしら。"
en: Alright then. There are several items I need you to bring, but they should all be easy to find.
en_grezzo: "Alright then. There are several items I need you to bring, but they should all be easy to find."
it: Allora. Gli oggetti che mi servono sono diversi, quindi comincerei da quelli facili.

jp: そうね。今回持ってきてほしいアイテムは変化の杖よ。
jp_grezzo: "そうね。今回持ってきてほしいアイテムは変化の杖よ。"
en: Okay. This time I want you to bring me a rod of change creature.
en_grezzo: "Okay. This time I want you to bring me a rod of change creature."
it: Dunque. Stavolta voglio che mi porti una bacchetta di mutamento di creatura.

jp: そうね。今回持ってきてほしいアイテムは復活の書よ。
jp_grezzo: "そうね。今回持ってきてほしいアイテムは復活の書よ。"
en: Okay. This time I want you to bring me a book of resurrection.
en_grezzo: "Okay. This time I want you to bring me a book of resurrection."
it: Dunque. Stavolta voglio che mi porti un libro di resurrezione.

jp: 今回で最後ね！持ってきてほしいアイテムは変異治療のポーションよ。
jp_grezzo: "今回で最後ね！持ってきてほしいアイテムは変異治療のポーションよ。"
en: Okay, this is the last, I promise! I need you to bring me a potion of cure mutation.
en_grezzo: "Okay, this is the last, I promise! I need you to bring me a potion of cure mutation."
it: Con questo siamo all'ultimo! Voglio che mi porti una pozione di cura della mutazione.

jp: 渡す
jp_grezzo: "渡す"
en: (Hand one over)
en_grezzo: "(Hand one over)"
it: (Consegnarne uno)

jp: 渡さない
jp_grezzo: "渡さない"
en: (Don't hand one over)
en_grezzo: "(Don't hand one over)"
it: (Non consegnare niente)

jp: あら？もしかして今持っていたりするんじゃない？
jp_grezzo: "あら？もしかして今持っていたりするんじゃない？"
en: Oh? Do you possibly have one with you?
en_grezzo: "Oh? Do you possibly have one with you?"
it: Ah? Che sia il caso di chiederti se ce l'hai già addosso?

jp: そう…？急いでもらえると助かるわ。
jp_grezzo: "そう…？急いでもらえると助かるわ。"
en: Oh...? It'd really help me out if you could hurry.
en_grezzo: "Oh...? It'd really help me out if you could hurry."
it: Ah, no...? Se fai in fretta mi rendi un favore.

jp: ありがとうねぇ、アリだけに。
jp_grezzo: "ありがとうねぇ、アリだけに。"
en: Thank you so much!
en_grezzo: "Thank you so much!"
it: Grazie mille, eh. E non è una formicalità.

jp: えーと…持ってきてもらったアイテムたちを、館長さんに教えてもらった通りの配分で合成して…さらに私の調達してきたゴッドロイヤルゼリーと混ぜれば…。
jp_grezzo: "えーと…持ってきてもらったアイテムたちを、館長さんに教えてもらった通りの配分で合成して…さらに私の調達してきたゴッドロイヤルゼリーと混ぜれば…。"
en: Umm... If I take these items and synthesize them together like the librarian told me... and then mix all that with the godly royal jelly I have...
en_grezzo: "Umm... If I take these items and synthesize them together like the librarian told me... and then mix all that with the godly royal jelly I have..."
it: Ehm... Combino quel che mi hai portato nelle dosi che mi ha detto il direttore della biblioteca... e ci mescolo la pappa reale divina che mi sono procurata...

jp: よし、特殊変異治療薬の完成よ！ちょっと後片付けがあるから、アリスに薬をあげるところまでお願いするわ。
jp_grezzo: "よし、特殊変異治療薬の完成よ！ちょっと後片付けがあるから、アリスに薬をあげるところまでお願いするわ。"
en: Alright, the mutation treatment is complete! Please give it to Alice while I take care of the clean up here.
en_grezzo: "Alright, the mutation treatment is complete! Please give it to Alice while I take care of the clean up here."
it: Ecco, la cura per la mutazione speciale è pronta! Io riordino qui: ad Alice dalla tu, per favore.

jp: [特殊変異治療薬]を手に入れた。
jp_grezzo: "[特殊変異治療薬]を手に入れた。"
en: You obtain the [EX Mutation Treatment]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [EX Mutation Treatment]!"
it: Hai ottenuto la [cura per la mutazione speciale].

jp: あの子のためにも、可及的速やかに頼むわ。
jp_grezzo: "あの子のためにも、可及的速やかに頼むわ。"
en: It's for that child, so please find it as soon as possible.
en_grezzo: "It's for that child, so please find it as soon as possible."
it: È per quella creaturina: sbrigati il più possibile.

jp: 大変なのよ！ある朝、目が覚めたらうちのアリスがあんなおぞましい姿に変身していたの！すっかり人語も喋れなくなって…！
jp_grezzo: "大変なのよ！ある朝、目が覚めたらうちのアリスがあんなおぞましい姿に変身していたの！すっかり人語も喋れなくなって…！"
en: This is terrible! This morning when I woke up, our poor little Alice had transformed into such a horrifying form! She can't even speak the human language any more...!
en_grezzo: "This is terrible! This morning when I woke up, our poor little Alice had transformed into such a horrifying form! She can't even speak the human language any more...!"
it: È una tragedia! Una mattina mi sveglio e la nostra Alice si era trasformata in quel coso orribile! E non riesce più nemmeno a parlare come le persone...!

jp: 手伝わない
jp_grezzo: "手伝わない"
en: Not my problem.
en_grezzo: "Not my problem."
it: Non è affar mio

jp: 手伝う
jp_grezzo: "手伝う"
en: Let me help.
en_grezzo: "Let me help."
it: Ti do una mano

jp: ここの館長さんに話を聞いたんだけど、なんでも元の姿に戻すには複数のアイテムが必要らしいのよ。報酬は出すから、アイテム集めを手伝ってくれないかしら？
jp_grezzo: "ここの館長さんに話を聞いたんだけど、なんでも元の姿に戻すには複数のアイテムが必要らしいのよ。報酬は出すから、アイテム集めを手伝ってくれないかしら？"
en: I've spoken to the chief librarian here, and it seems like several items are needed to restore her original form. I'll give you a reward if you'll gather the items for me.
en_grezzo: "I've spoken to the chief librarian here, and it seems like several items are needed to restore her original form. I'll give you a reward if you'll gather the items for me."
it: Ne ho parlato con il direttore della biblioteca qui, e pare che per rimetterla com'era servano diversi oggetti. Il compenso c'è: non è che mi aiuteresti a raccoglierli?

jp: ありがとうね！これで蟲の研究に専念できるわぁ。
jp_grezzo: "ありがとうね！これで蟲の研究に専念できるわぁ。"
en: Thank you very much! Now I can concentrate on my study of insects.
en_grezzo: "Thank you very much! Now I can concentrate on my study of insects."
it: Grazie mille! Così posso dedicarmi anima e corpo allo studio degli insetti.

jp: そんな！このままじゃ私、娘に顔向けできないわ…。
jp_grezzo: "そんな！このままじゃ私、娘に顔向けできないわ…。"
en: But! How am I going to explain this to my daughter...
en_grezzo: "But! How am I going to explain this to my daughter..."
it: Ma no! E adesso come la guardo in faccia, mia figlia...
